legend: Every minute of the contest, some team decides that a statement is ambiguous and sends a clarification request. Elisa is the judge on duty at the clarification desk, and her shift lasts exactly $$$2n$$$ minutes. In that time she must take exactly $$$n$$$ requests and answer every one of them.

The jury rates a shift with an operations score. Taking a request the moment it arrives raises that score, because the team stops waiting. Answering lowers it, because a written reply has to be read by the whole jury before it goes out.
During minute $$$i$$$ Elisa must do exactly one of the following:
Take the request that arrived this minute. The score rises by $$$a_i$$$, and the request joins her queue, where it waits to be answered on a later minute.
Answer one request that she took earlier and has not answered yet. The score falls by $$$b_i$$$.

A request can only be answered after it has been taken. When the $$$2n$$$ minutes are over, Elisa must have taken exactly $$$n$$$ requests and answered all of them. Determine the highest operations score she can finish her shift with.
input: The first line contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 10^5$$$) — the number of requests Elisa must take and answer.
The second line contains $$$2n$$$ integers $$$a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_{2n}$$$ ($$$1 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$) — the score gained by taking the request that arrives on minute $$$i$$$.
The third line contains $$$2n$$$ integers $$$b_1,b_2,\ldots,b_{2n}$$$ ($$$1 \le b_i \le 10^9$$$) — the score lost by answering a request on minute $$$i$$$.
output: Print one integer — the highest operations score Elisa can finish her shift with, having taken and answered exactly $$$n$$$ requests.

legend.ai: 比赛期间，每一分钟都会有某支队伍认为题面存在歧义，并发送澄清请求。Elisa 是负责澄清事务的裁判，她的值班时间恰好持续 $$$2n$$$ 分钟。在此期间，她必须恰好处理 $$$n$$$ 个请求，并回答其中的每一个。
评审团会根据操作得分评价一次值班。请求一到就立即接手会提高得分，因为团队不再需要等待。回复请求则会降低得分，因为书面回复必须先由整个评审团阅读后才能发出。
在第 $$$i$$$ 分钟内，Elisa 必须恰好执行以下操作之一：
处理本分钟到达的请求。分数增加 $$$a_i$$$，该请求加入她的队列，等待在之后的某一分钟得到答复。
回答她之前提出但尚未得到答复的一个请求。得分会降低 $$$b_i$$$。
只有在接取请求后才能回答该请求。$$$2n$$$ 分钟结束时，Elisa 必须恰好接取 $$$n$$$ 个请求，并将它们全部回答。求她结束值班时能够获得的最高操作分数。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 10^5$$$) —— Elisa 必须接收并回答的请求数量。
第二行包含 $$$2n$$$ 个整数 $$$a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_{2n}$$$ ($$$1 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$) —— 表示接受在第 $$$i$$$ 分钟到达的请求所获得的分数。
第三行包含 $$$2n$$$ 个整数 $$$b_1,b_2,\ldots,b_{2n}$$$($$$1 \le b_i \le 10^9$$$)——表示在第 $$$i$$$ 分钟响应请求所损失的分数。

output.ai: 输出一个整数——Elisa 在接收并回答了恰好 $$$n$$$ 个请求后结束轮班时所能获得的最高运营得分。
